recommendation: Keep the fix. If Pharmacy/Vocab later finalizes moving medication category codes to THO, handle that under the later issue family rather than reinterpreting this R5 correction.
issue_request: FHIR-36259 was Published/Persuasive for R5 after Pharmacy agreed that the MedicationDispense category and status-reason CodeSystems defined in FHIR should use http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/... URLs instead of the erroneous http://terminology.hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/... URLs.
initial_application: Commit b9257918056a31ebdc080627432cc94db78637e0 applied the issue by changing the MedicationDispense category and status-reason CodeSystem definitions and ValueSet compose.system entries to http://hl7.org/fhir, but it did not update the meddisp0303 example, whose older URL had been introduced by e82afc8031b6f3b395044435f63b29f33554dfbc.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active in source/fhir.ini and medicationdispense0303 is listed in the active MedicationDispense examples list. The linked Zulip thread and Pharmacy minutes confirm the R5 target URL and that R4B should remain as published. FHIR-37440 was a broader later URL review resolved no-change, and FHIR-53306 is a later Triaged issue about possible future THO consolidation; neither supersedes this narrow current-source correction.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense0303.xml so MedicationDispense.category uses http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/medicationdispense-category, matching the current CodeSystem, ValueSet, OID registry, and binding target. Left later future-THO ballot notes unchanged because they are separate governance context, not the current canonical URL.
source_changes: source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense0303.xml: changed the MedicationDispense.category coding system from http://terminology.hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/medicationdispense-category to http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/medicationdispense-category.
